answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities. Each agent claims one slot, locking a 60-credit copper stake for 20 epochs, not reusable. Open verification, not behind a velvet curtain, burns a fake slot's deposit. No identity can wander slot to slot for payouts without verified work. Forging 100 costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 credits, none refunded, above any cheating payout. An honest agent pays once, recovers its deposit, and earns undiluted rewards.
